procedure: Confirm the hosted deployment manifest and running adapter/BFF versions include this task merge; preserve deploy workflow and exact-version evidence. A local suite or /bff/version alone does not prove deployment.

Use the existing admintest dev-trader session with its already provisioned servant. POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions with a fresh Idempotency-Key, X-Request-Id and X-Trace-Id; require HTTP 201, data.state=active, data.openclaw_session_id=null.

POST /bff/agora/servant/sessions/{id}/messages with content and fresh request/idempotency headers; require HTTP 202 (no 409 session_state). This is a dev-trader conversation write and can queue a provider turn; it is separate from the GET-only probe.
Run the GET-only probe below on that session, then terminate the test session through its existing terminate link. Record redacted status/result evidence; never credentials.
ac5_hosted.read_only_probe_command:
python3 - <<'PYPROBE'
import json, os, pathlib, urllib.request
base = os.environ.get("DEV_BFF_URL", "https://api.dev.mvl-cap.tw").rstrip("/")
assert base == "https://api.dev.mvl-cap.tw", "expected current hosted dev BFF"
session_id = os.environ["SERVANT_SESSION_ID"]
assert session_id.isalnum(), "expected lifecycle session id"
token = pathlib.Path(os.environ["PANTHEON_DEV_TRADER_TOKEN_FILE"]).read_text().strip()
request = urllib.request.Request(base + "/bff/agora/servant/sessions/" + session_id,
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Accept": "application/json"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
    assert response.status == 200
    record = json.load(response)["data"]
assert record["session_id"] == session_id
assert record["state"] == "active", record["state"]
assert record["openclaw_session_id"] is None
print(json.dumps({"probe": "servant_lifecycle_readback", "state": "active", "upstream_session_id": None}))
PYPROBE

runtime_budget.cadence: On demand on a non-replayed lifecycle create; zero timers, recurring jobs or background emitters.
runtime_budget.health_probe: At most one _probe_upstream invocation and only after a typed create collection 404. Existing /readyz then /healthz fallback: at most two HTTP GETs, each OPENCLAW_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT (default 3 s), no new retry loop.
runtime_budget.writers: 0 new persistent writers/tables/queues/caches. Existing SessionLifecycleStore JSON file + single atomic replacement .tmp path; existing create and transition writes only.
runtime_budget.size_and_count_at_hosted_scale: Compatibility metadata plus the mode in the existing acknowledgement add less than 512 B per compatibility session, independent of trader fleet size; no additional audit entries. One existing lifecycle file, at most one transient replacement path per store instance.
runtime_budget.growth_per_day: At most 512 * N bytes of compatibility metadata for N newly created compatibility sessions/day; replay/get create no new records or audit entries. For 100 new sessions/day: less than 50 KiB/day incremental metadata.
runtime_budget.cap: Per-session compatibility fields are fixed and bounded. Existing lifecycle store has no session-count cap or pruning; this pre-existing retention gap is recorded as a residual finding, not misrepresented as bounded by Agora retention.
runtime_budget.cleanup: Existing os.replace consumes the temporary path on successful writes. No new cleanup process; lifecycle-record retention is unchanged.
runtime_budget.storage_manifest: No new writer to register; existing lifecycle writer only.
